# records

:::info[Typed specification]

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`adapters/grafana/spec/ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/grafana/spec/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

:::

The bounded data-source records `datasources.list` returns, read from Grafana's `GET /api/datasources`.

`connectors_grafana.records` is one of connectors_grafana's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `DatasourceAccess`

`connectors_grafana.records.DatasourceAccess` is one of `proxy` and `direct`.

### `DatasourceList`

`connectors_grafana.records.DatasourceList` is a record of two fields:

- `items` — `List<connectors_grafana.records.DatasourceRecord>`
- `complete` — `Boolean`

Every value satisfies `items.count <= 1000`.

### `DatasourceRecord`

`connectors_grafana.records.DatasourceRecord` is a record of five fields:

- `uid` — `connectors_grafana.records.DatasourceUid`
- `name` — `String`
- `type` — `String`
- `access` — `connectors_grafana.records.DatasourceAccess`
- `is_default` — `Boolean`

Every value satisfies `(name.count >= 1 and name.count <= 190)` and `(type.count >= 1 and type.count <= 128)`.

### `DatasourceUid`

`connectors_grafana.records.DatasourceUid` wraps `String` and is not interchangeable with one: the whole value of naming it separately is the crossings the model then refuses. Its characters are drawn from `ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_-`. Every value satisfies `(value.count >= 1 and value.count <= 40)`.

One of the types above is reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors_grafana.records.DatasourceList`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names it, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
